title: Let parseLine split on a delimiter other than a comma
description: `parseLine` in `src/csv.js` only splits on commas, and some of our files use semicolons or tabs. Add an options argument, `parseLine(line, { delimiter })`, with a comma as the default. Quoting works the same whatever the delimiter: a quoted field may contain the delimiter, and a doubled quote inside one is a literal quote. With another delimiter, a comma is an ordinary character.
acceptance_criteria: with a delimiter other than a comma, commas are kept inside fields
calling `parseLine(line)` without options behaves exactly as before, and `npm test` passes
